factCards.text: The Hobbit was published by George Allen and Unwin in September 1937; The Lord of the Rings followed in three volumes in 1954 and 1955.
factCards.sourceTitle: George Allen and Unwin publication records

factCards.text: Terry Pratchett wrote forty-one Discworld novels, from The Colour of Magic in 1983 to The Shepherd's Crown in 2015.
factCards.sourceTitle: Colin Smythe and Transworld bibliography of Terry Pratchett

factCards.text: Ursula K. Le Guin's Earthsea began with A Wizard of Earthsea in 1968 and eventually ran to six volumes, the last two published in 2001.
factCards.sourceTitle: Parnassus Press and Houghton Mifflin editions; the count depends on whether a story collection is included
